name: tali-dash-docsets
description: DSH plugin: native dash_list_docsets / dash_search / dash_get_page tools over the local HTTP API of Dash 8 (the macOS documentation browser), with HTML-to-Markdown page conversion (section scoping, MathML to LaTeX).

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/gen-tool-docs.mjs --check
